about: VELA-2026-002 (0.9.9 hotfix, backported from feat/multisig-account §31): the parent-Safe guard. A request from a site may never make this account act for a Safe it owns — any contract whose isOwner(signer) reads true. v0.9.8 has no multisig list, so every Safe a request would act for is read on chain first. `input` is vela_core::app::parent_safe_guard::CheckInput; `expect` is check(input) (ParentVerdict). `answers` are the shell's answers to ReadSafeOwner (SafeOwnerAnswer); `at_submit` is the submit chokepoint's form, where a Safe nobody read is refused 'unchecked'. A SafeTx the parent rule clears is still refused by the self-call guard (spec 081), whatever its domain. Replayed by rust/crates/vela-core/tests/app_parent_safe_guard.rs, wasm (parentSafeCheck, verify-web), uniffi (parent_safe_check) and the signing page's own suite (the page cannot read the chain, so it refuses every refused or read shape here on any target).
